    Serialized Form

    • Package org.springframework.security.boot.jwt.authentication

      • Class org.springframework.security.boot.jwt.authentication.JwtAuthenticationToken

        class JwtAuthenticationToken extends org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • credentials
            Object credentials
            The raw credentials supplied with the login attempt — usually the bearer JWT string. Cleared by JwtAuthenticationToken.eraseCredentials() once the token has been authenticated.
          • latitude
            double latitude
            Optional latest known latitude of the user device, expressed in decimal degrees. Defaults to 0.0 when not supplied.
          • longitude
            double longitude
            Optional latest known longitude of the user device, expressed in decimal degrees. Defaults to 0.0 when not supplied.
          • principal
            Object principal
            The authenticated principal (typically a username, user-id, or a fully resolved UserDetails instance after authentication). Immutable for the lifetime of this token.
          • sign
            String sign
            Optional request parameter signature used for replay-protection / anti-tamper checks. May be null when the caller does not participate in the signing scheme.

      • Class org.springframework.security.boot.jwt.authentication.JwtAuthorizationToken

        class JwtAuthorizationToken extends org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken implements Serializable

        • Serialized Fields

          • credentials
            Object credentials
            The credentials originally supplied with the JWT. The trusted constructor invokes JwtAuthorizationToken.eraseCredentials() immediately, so instances built by that constructor always expose null.
          • latitude
            double latitude
            Optional latest known latitude of the user device in decimal degrees. Defaults to 0.0.
          • longitude
            double longitude
            Optional latest known longitude of the user device in decimal degrees. Defaults to 0.0.
          • principal
            Object principal
            The trusted principal associated with the JWT (e.g. a username, a user-id or a fully resolved UserDetails). Immutable for the lifetime of this token.
          • sign
            String sign
            Optional request parameter signature carried alongside the authorization request. May be null when no signing scheme is in effect.
